text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... To think I would encounter this<n>femme fatale
on the day of my<n>genesis! Fate is truly an
unstoppable<n>force!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're as vocal as ever. Are you that<n>eager to
receive well wishes and<n>flowers from me?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah, surely you mean a blue<n>delphinium-filled
bouquet. But I ask<n>not for such mercy nor
blessings!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The opposite is true! Today, I shall be<n>the one
celebrating! Once again, the<n>stars have completed
their waltz,<n>marking another year since my<n>descent
from Chaos and the birth of a<n>new Gaia!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And Ramonu... Today, I shall be the<n>one to
congratulate you, for you have<n>had the fortune of
crossing paths with<n>me. Allow me to fill your cup
personally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Such a grandiose invitation. Might I<n>request a glass
of amrita?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What need do you have for Aion<n>when you are
already counted among<n>the stars? No, what I have
is far more<n>invigorating—it will burn your very
psyche!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have a taste, shall we? I'll<n>accept your
toast to the world... and<n>the passion within it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's the spirit, my lady! Now,<n>take my
hand! And let us begin this<n>celebration of me, by
none other than<n>me!
